scientific_integrity: The new theorem is restricted to sharp maxima and complete maximizing necklaces; no universal circular-square bound is claimed. Exhaustive finite checks are corroborative, while the unrestricted n>=25 proof is analytic.
scientific_limitations: Only binary circles of exactly three ones, literal ordinary squares of total length at most the circumference, and their fixed-length extrema. The pointwise square-count formula is preexisting and is not claimed as original. Results are same-model reviewed; no independent validation.
title: Sharp square-factor diversity of three-marker binary circles
